text: Even though the creator of a DEX plays a limited role in its evolution, the code that provides the exchange's operational rules may still be subject to the centralized control of certain developers, and a completely open source DEX with no ongoing developer involvement remains untested.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization and Feedback Effects (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808852
abstract: the code that provides the operational rules of the exchange may still be subject to the centralized control of certain developers. The idea of a completely open source DEX without any ongoing developer involvement remains untested.
